response.overview: After battering a couple of bigots with his skateboard, Bo breaks into the flat of his ex-lover, who holds resentment towards him since their messy separation. She is now a wellness loving, trad wife, and he is a rebellious rogue of a transsexual. Why (Do U) Care? explores identity and lost queerness.
response.tagline: On the run, Bo goes on a journey of rebellion, assimilation and broken bonds.
response.title: Why (Do U) Care
